h5creaturesRumor0.text: I hear that even if a whole stack of Phoenixes is wiped out, they rise again from the flames at full strength. Luckily, only once per battle.

h5creaturesRumor1.text: Don't think numbers keep you safe: when a Death Knight gets lucky, one swing of his sword can cut a whole troop in half.

h5creaturesRumor2.text: Never provoke a wolf pack! A hunter told me that when a wolf howls, it calls just as many wolves again.

h5creaturesRumor3.text: Fighting an Land Elemental is like arguing with a rock: however many times you hit it, it hits you back just as many times, and never tires.
